name: flip-card
title: Flip Card
description: Two-sided card that turns over in 3D on tap — it lifts toward you half-way and its shadow narrows as it goes edge-on, like a real card. Flips left/right or top/bottom, controlled or uncontrolled, and swaps faces exactly at 90° so Android never flickers.
props: First face. Sets the card's size.
Second face, filling the same box.
Controlled side — true shows the back.
Turn around the vertical or the horizontal axis.
Flip on tap, or only through `flipped`.
Depth of the effect — smaller is more dramatic.
Soft shadow that narrows as the card turns edge-on.
